messages:
liz: Kicking off a phased feature-flag cutover for rerank_zero_shot_v2 in prod. Change window 23:30-02:00 UTC. Plan: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 15m holds and health checks at each step. Pin current model version for fallback. @sre-oncall pls ack :eyes:
akash: acked. I'll watch P99 latency and 5xx. What are rollback thresholds?
maria: +1. Also monitor cost-per-call; v2 uses a longer context so token cost could spike.
dan: Deploy-bot will run the toggle commands, but we need the exact commands and the pin/unpin steps in the runbook.
liz: Commands: `deploy-bot:ff-toggle --flag rerank_zero_shot_v2 --env prod --percent 5` then increase. Rollback: `deploy-bot:ff-toggle --flag rerank_zero_shot_v2 --env prod --percent 0` and `deploy-bot:pin-model --model rerank_v1 --env prod` (if needed).
metrics-bot: Pre-rollout checks passed: error budget ok, infra headroom 24 GPUs idle in pool, recent regression tests green.
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: set rerank_zero_shot_v2 to 5% in prod (rollout id: r-20261107-001).
sre-oncall: Watching. If P99 > 800ms for 3 consecutive intervals or 5xx rate > 1% trigger rollback. Also if success rate drops > 2% absolute.
akash: 5% hold started. No red flags after 5m. Latency +12% but still under 700ms P99. Cost +8% (expected).
maria: Metrics look stable, error rate flat. Proceeding to 20% in 5m.
deploy-bot: Increasing to 20% (rollout id: r-20261107-001).
metrics-bot: 2m after 20%: P50 +8%, P95 +15%, P99 +25% (now 760ms), errors 0.3%. Token cost +12%.
dan: Good to continue. Keep close eye on tail latency.
sre-oncall: Reminder: if we see a steady trend of P99 rising across holds, prefer rollback and open an incident rather than risk full cutover.
liz: Agreed. Next hold at 20m, then 60% -> 100%. If any anomaly, we'll unpin and drop to rerank_v1 and open rollback.
akash: 20% hold complete, moving to 60% now.
deploy-bot: Increasing to 60%.
metrics-bot: 4m after 60%: P99 980ms, 5xx 0.9%, success rate -1.5%. Notes: P99 crossed 900ms threshold (soft).
maria: Hmm P99 trend is concerning, approaching soft threshold. Any spike in request concurrency?
akash: Observed a surge from one bulk-user batch at 23:45 UTC. It's responsible for ~40% of token increase.
dan: Can we exclude that customer from the rollout temporarily? Use segmentation in the flag.
liz: Yes—plan change: stop further increase, segment flag to exclude heavy-batch customers, and continue monitoring for 15m. If P99 drops back under 850ms we'll resume to 100%, otherwise rollback.
deploy-bot: Applying segmentation: rerank_zero_shot_v2 exclude group heavy_batch_customers.
sre-oncall: After segmentation, P99 down to 720ms in 3m. 5xx 0.2%. Looks good.
akash: Great. Resuming to 100% with 10m hold at full traffic.
deploy-bot: Increasing to 100% (rollout id: r-20261107-001).
metrics-bot: 6m post-100%: P99 740ms, 5xx 0.3%, cost +14% overall. No errors.
maria: Re-run smoke tests for downstream ranking consumers to validate outputs.
dan: Smoke results: pass, no correctness regressions detected on sampled prompt set.
liz: Thanks everyone. Closing change window early at 00:40 UTC since stability achieved. Runbook notes: 1) Segmented heavy_batch_customers during rollout; 2) Observed token cost +14% — Optimize prompt length in follow-up ticket; 3) Pin fallback ready (rerank_v1).
sre-oncall: Marking post-deploy observation for 48h. If any regression appears, roll back to pinned rerank_v1.
akash: Leaving a quick snippet for docs: `ff-toggle --flag rerank_zero_shot_v2 --env prod --percent X --exclude-group heavy_batch_customers`
liz: :tada: rollout successful. I'll add notes to release PR and update release-notes channel.
deploy-bot: Rollout r-20261107-001 completed at 00:40 UTC.
